claim_verdicts.evidence: _send: `createOrder(order.items, idempotencyKey: order.idempotencyKey)`; `queue.markSent(order, result); return null;`; `case 400 || 409: queue.markRejected(order, problem.detail); return null;`. createOrder returns OrderResult only on 201 (`if (response.statusCode != 201) throw ApiProblem.fromResponse(response)`).

Round 2: createOrder: `on http.ClientException { throw ApiUnreachable(); }`, `if (const [502, 503, 504].contains(response.statusCode)) throw ApiUnreachable();`, `if (response.statusCode != 201) throw ApiProblem.fromResponse(response);`. _send: ApiUnreachable and `default` -> notSent; 429 -> rateLimited with resumeAt only when retryAfter != null; `case 401: return const SyncState(pause: SyncPause.signInNeeded);` (no resumeAt, so a later trigger is not blocked). No queue call on these paths.

Round 2: `retryAfter: _seconds(response.headers['retry-after'])`; `static Duration? _seconds(String? header) { final seconds = int.tryParse(header ?? ''); return seconds == null ? null : Duration(seconds: seconds); }` - null when missing or not an integer, as the claim and section 5 now say.
